concepts.why: The patient has a small, pearly lesion on the left lower eyelid, which is a common presentation of basal cell carcinoma, and the biopsy results confirm the diagnosis of nodular BCC with an infiltrative pattern.

The patient has contraction of the conjunctival mucosal tissue and increased scleral show, which are characteristic of cicatricial ectropion, and the cicatricial effects causing conjunctival shrinkage and eyelid skin contracture support this diagnosis.

The patient has a history of anophthalmic socket and has undergone multiple surgeries, which increases the risk of anophthalmic socket syndrome, and the spontaneous extrusion of the ocular prosthesis and cicatricial effects support this diagnosis.
